name: codex-goal-supervisor
description: Low-noise execution convergence and optional reproducible Agent assembly for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex execution aligned, verifiable, reusable, and convergent.
interface.longDescription: Codex Supervisor is a low-noise execution-convergence tool with one capability core and inherited runtime profiles. The General Profile keeps ordinary Codex work unblocked while exposing observer, evidence, context, procedure, specialist, validation, recovery, and reproducible Agent assembly capabilities on demand. The Goal Profile inherits that baseline and strengthens durable North Star, detailed Goal, return-path, route, deviation, phase, and final-certification behavior without duplicating implementations or forcing tickets, receipts, and governance ceremony onto ordinary work.
capabilities: Background advisory observation
Inherited General and Goal capability profiles
Content-aware project runtime parity and recovery
Dual North Star and detailed Goal-contract alignment
Sparse read-only Codex CLI LLM Judge
Goal-return recovery after bounded interruptions and compaction
Required General instruction hygiene for resolved corrections and compacted temporary requests
Hierarchical local context continuity for large reads
Evidence-backed final North Star regression certification
Silent product-write verification debt with completion-claim reminders
Optional bounded tickets
Optional company roles, Custodian, Auditor, and mark-only Janitor
Optional pinned specialist role library with exact upstream prompts
Confidence-routed industry-expert input for detailed Goal authoring
Goal-wide recovery from local external-prerequisite stalls
User-confirmed durable North Star evolution
Goal-authored open-source reuse decisions with 24-hour long-task refresh
Hour-level capability segments with real wall-clock deadlines
Live project-local technical route with current-node visualization
First-principle route convergence with targeted stagnation recovery
Verified project-local procedure Skills and idempotent service runners
Evidence-bearing cross-thread collaboration liveness
Hierarchical parent-child Goal workstreams for independent Codex tasks
Optional reproducible Agent assembly with isolated community capability staging
Versioned Git marketplace auto-update for new Codex sessions
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Supervisor only where it creates net execution benefit; keep ordinary work unblocked.
